name: vome-connect
description: Connects Claude Code to your Home Assistant through Vome's hosted MCP endpoint, with one key from the Vome app in Home Assistant (no sign-up) or from vome.io. Nothing to install or run locally.

vome_key.title: Vome key
vome_key.description: Starts vh_. In Home Assistant: the Vome app, Agent tab (no sign-up). Or vome.io: Account, API tokens.

home.title: Start on this home (optional)
home.description: An instance id from vomehome_list_instances, so sessions always start on that home. Leave empty to resume whichever you used last.
